system: Chemical Pipe Fittings & Flow Control Components
function: Seamless equal tee for pipe branching
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pipe fitting application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by seamless equal tee for pipe branching and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with Class 6g gauge

commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment — critical for seamless equal tee performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) suitable for Seamless equal tee for pipe branching?
faq.a: Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pipe fitting operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for seamless equal tee requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. seamless equal tee components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for seamless equal tee application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet seamless equal tee specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
